submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"

finding.headline: "Incision Care vs. Cultural Water Taboo"
finding.problem: "My mother-in-law says rub shea butter on it; the hospital says keep it dry and clean. I don't know who to believe and I'm scared it'll get infected."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
finding.person: A 34-yr-old Lagos mom told by her aunt "don't let water touch the wound or it won't close," but her nurse said keep it clean; she's terrified of infection and ashamed to question elders.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module / chapter (cultural-myth vs medical fact) in A1 and H products.". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
